label: agent loop • create a real .xlsx with file_write (no CSV-with-xlsx-name, no shell)
query: Create budget.xlsx with the columns Item and Amount and these rows: Rent 1200, Groceries 450, Transit 90. Then confirm it was written.
notes: file_write generates a spreadsheet package for the .xlsx extension from CSV/TSV/JSON rows. The command assertion proves the output is an OOXML zip (xl/workbook.xml), not CSV bytes renamed.
